script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: ASCEND

Genre: Sci-Fi

Theme: Ambition

FADE IN:

INT. NIGHT SKY - STARFIELD

A single star winks out, leaving behind a trail of light.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
In the vastness of the cosmos...

INT. LAB - DAY

Prof. EVELYN JAMES (45s, tenacious, brilliant) stands before her team, hands on hips.

PROF. JAMES
Seventy-two hours, people. We have to crack this.

DR. RICHARD WANG (35s, tech-savvy, ambitious)
What if we're going about this all wrong?

PROF. JAMES
We're not. We've got the best team, the best resources. We're close.

MARCOS PEREZ (28s, resourceful, determined)
But what if there's another way?

EXT. CITY - NIGHT

Marcos, in a hoodie, sneaks into a rival lab, bypassing security systems.

INT. RIVAL LAB - NIGHT

Marcos discovers a holographic blueprint of a new tech. He snaps a picture.

EXT. CITY STREETS - NIGHT

Marcos calls Prof. James.

MARCOS
Professor, I think I found something.

INT. LAB - DAY

Prof. James studies Marcos' photo.

PROF. JAMES
This could be our breakthrough.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

The team works late into the night, their minds focused.

DR. WANG
Professor, we've got something.

INT. LAB - DAY

Prof. James leads the team in a triumphant cheer.

PROF. JAMES
Yes! We're going to change the world!

INT. NIGHT SKY - STARFIELD

The starfield comes alive with new stars, each representing a groundbreaking discovery.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
And so, in the vastness of the cosmos...

FADE OUT.
